title: Options route answer
description: The answer of the route GET /.well-known/procurauth/resources (protocol 5.6 to 5.8). It lists the children of a node, one page at a time. A caller accepts an answer of 64 KiB with 50 items, an id of 256 bytes and a label of 60 characters. A service stays within these numbers, but a schema does not enforce them. The tool access-lint gives a warning above them. A receiver ignores a member that it does not know.

items.description: The children of the node, in the order of the service.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, or null on the last page. The caller treats it as opaque text.

id.description: The id of the child, as protocol 4.1 says. The service does not encode it.

label.description: A short text for the form, for example the id itself.

has_children.description: True when the route can list children below this child.
